run: SEED REPLICATION of experiment:tm-neuron-period-pc-1001: the PC's exact configuration at NEW training seeds; only train_seed changes

model.note: 1 layer: tokens (a, b, '=') with '=' = id 113; causal attention (no biases on Q/K/V/O), MLP W_in+b_in -> ReLU -> W_out+b_out, residual stream only (no LayerNorm), unembed (no bias) read at the '=' position (index 2) -> logits over 113 classes = (a+b) mod 113. Init: W_E, W_pos ~ N(0, 1/d_model); Linear layers PyTorch default

split_def: all 113*113 pairs (a, b), index a*113+b; numpy default_rng(split_seed).permutation; first floor(0.3*12769) = 3830 = train, the rest (8939) = held-out test
loss: cross entropy, log-softmax in float64, full batch over the 3830 train pairs
early_stop: stop once held-out acc >= 0.99 at EVERY eval over the last 1000 steps (11 consecutive evals at eval_every 100); grok_step = the first eval step of that sustained run
fallback: DISABLED: no fallback seed; a seed that does not grok by step_cap / wall_cap_s is recorded as not grokked
sweep_def: for each b in b_set: inputs (a, b, '=') for a = 0..112; read the MLP post-ReLU activations (512) at the '=' position -> acts (5, 113, 512) float32, saved
pipeline: IMPORTED unchanged from osc_neuron_period2.py: dpeak (= detrend over span{1, a} then run 1's peakiness) and detrended_null; peakiness = max non-DC rfft power / total non-DC power over the 113-long a series, dominant bin k in 1..56
statistic: per neuron: detrended peakiness per b, averaged over the 5 b -> pk; dominant frequency k = the most common per-b dominant bin over the 5 b (ties -> smallest k)
null_def: detrended label-shuffled null: for each b, osc_neuron_period2.detrended_null(acts_b, 20, null_seed) (permute a FIRST, then detrend, then peakiness; the same 20 permutations for every b) -> (20, 512) per b, averaged over b -> pooled 10240 values, 99.9th pct
twin_def: random-init twin: the SAME architecture built after torch.manual_seed(twin_seed), untrained, same sweep and statistic; null 2 = max pk over its 512 neurons
p1_set: neurons with pk > null q999 AND pk > twin max (both strict); fraction over all 512
p2_def: dominant frequencies of the P1 neurons sorted by count (desc, ties smallest k); n_cover = the fewest of them whose counts sum to >= 0.8 * |P1|; pass = |P1| > 0 and n_cover <= 6
verdict_rule: EVALUATED IN THIS ORDER: (1) VOID if < 2 of the 3 seeds grok (held-out acc >= 0.99 held 1000 steps within step_cap 40000 / wall_cap_s), or any random set not size-matched / intersecting its family, or acts shape != (5,113,512), or the params.json sha256 differs from the one recorded at launch; (2) else DISPROVED if any grokked seed fails P1, P2 or P4; (3) else PROVED. P1 and P2 as in the PC params (p1_min_fraction, p2_max_freqs, p2_cover)
box_stop: training checks memory PSI some avg10 at each eval; >= 20 -> checkpoint and exit 3 (resumable)
wall_cap_note: PER SEED, 3 seeds sequential. 2400 -> 2680 (same decision): projected 3-seed time = 3 x (10200 steps, the PC's grok 9200 + the 1000-step hold) x 0.175 s = 5355 s; cap = 1.5 x 5355 = 8033 s total = 2680 per seed
p4_def: family = the P1 neurons sharing one dominant frequency; every family with >= family_floor (20) neurons is mean-ablated (post-ReLU at '=' replaced by its mean over ALL 12769 inputs), scored on the held-out split; each against 20 size-matched random sets (numpy default_rng(s).choice(512 minus the family, |family|, replace=False) for s in random_seeds), disjoint from the family. pass = at least ONE such family's drop > the MAX of its 20 random drops (strict); no family reaching the floor = fail
unscored: per seed: family frequencies and sizes; load-bearing (drop > random max) vs passenger (drop < random mean) counts; whether the top-6 W_E Fourier frequencies (power over the 113 token rows, k in 1..56) equal the frequencies of the families at the floor
resume: per-seed results_s<N>.json are written when a seed finishes; a relaunch skips finished seeds and resumes the current one from partial/ckpt_s<N>.pt (a restart of the post unit kills the detached run)
box_min_avail_note: 6000 -> 4000 (thought-master-new [decision] 13:37Z 10-01): 6 GB is the box rule for MODEL loads; this run is a toy (RSS ~0.5 GiB); PSI avg10 < 5 unchanged; scoring rules unchanged; recommitted before launch, no training had started
threads_note: 4 -> 1 (thought-master-new [decision] 15:18Z, path b): the run is a ptrace tracee of the post unit's strace (old wrap, TracerPid 185476 at 16:3xZ); 200-step timing probe at threads=1 under the tracer = 35.1 s = 175 s per 1000 steps (<= 300 s bar).
